command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest -q -o junit_family=legacy tests/test_*conduction.py --junitxml=results.xml
reference: Area 0.5 m², cell and wall capacities per area 1 and 2, conductance per area 2. For s=i*omega, heater P and ambient Ta, exact cell phasor=(P+h*Ta)/(s+(2*s+h)*(1+s/2)); material power=area*s*T. Absolute complex errors at omega=0.03125,1,32 rad/s, h=0 and 3 W/(m² K). An independent balanced case (unit area, h=0, volumetric sink -P) checks the DC and first-order coefficients of T=-P/(3+s) and Q=P+s*T.
